Residuals of a fitted ZISAR model

Source: R/methods.R
residuals.zisar.Rd

Response residuals \(y_i - E[y_i]\) or Pearson residuals, both conditional on the estimated latent field. Pearson residuals divide by the standard deviation of the zero-inflated negative binomial mixture, \(\mathrm{Var}(y_i) = (1 - \pi_i)\mu_i(1 + \mu_i/\kappa + \pi_i\mu_i)\).

Usage

# S3 method for class 'zisar'
residuals(object, type = c("pearson", "response"), ...)

Arguments

object

A fitted "zisar" object.

type

"pearson" or "response".

...

Not used.

Value

A numeric vector of residuals.

Details

Because the residuals condition on the mode of \(\eta\), which already absorbs most of the spatial structure, tests such as Moran's I on them have little power against remaining spatial dependence; the likelihood-ratio test of \(\rho = 0\) is preferable (see zisar()).
